output.brief: Last week's 5xx rate (0.41%) is a 34% relative rise, but it is within the range the service shows in ordinary weeks. The 26 weeks before it average 0.354% with a normal-band upper edge of 0.482%. Three earlier weeks were higher than 0.41% (0.44, 0.47, 0.51), and the investigations of those found no fault. The dashboard figures match a recount from raw logs, so this is not a counting artefact. Burn rate was 0.82x, well under the 2x paging line. Bookings and support contacts were unchanged. The worse error rate on new pods during the rollout is a cold-cache warm-up effect: it appears in every recent rollout, including a config-only redeploy, and adds only 10–20 errors. So it says nothing about v4.18. I'm fairly confident (about 75%) that no fault needs fixing. I can't fully rule out a small effect from the replica move or partner-sync traffic. Next steps: don't roll back, don't move the replica back, and don't mute alerting, since that would remove your protection. Note the week at ops review and apply the standard check to this week's rate. If it exceeds 0.482%, investigate then.
